## Problem and change

What failed or was missing, and what happens after this change?

## Compatibility

Mention changed public names, argument names, output shapes/numerical semantics, dependencies or checkpoint behavior. Write “unchanged” when applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and observed pass/skip counts. Name backends/platforms that were not tested.

- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass
- [ ] Relevant behavior and failure/boundary tests pass
- [ ] Legacy API fixture remains valid
- [ ] User-facing docs and changelog updated where needed
- [ ] No credentials, private data or built distributions committed
